text:
Type: floral print cotton cushion
Use: comfort and pattern on a sofa, armchair or bed; living room, bedroom
Style: farmhouse, traditional, Scandinavian
Materials: printed cotton, piped edge in matching blue
Colors: medium blue, white, light grey details
Shape: square cushion with a dense small-scale pattern of white flower heads and trailing stems, thin piped border, soft and plump, medium size
Feel: fresh, cheerful, homey, gentle
Goes with: white or cream sofas, light wood, blue and white ceramics, striped cushions; farmhouse, cottage or Scandinavian rooms
